preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 20,000.
The number of citizens m must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in citizens)
preconditions.description: Each citizen must live and work in distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The total number of puppies k must equal the sum of puppies given to citizens q and guardians e.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= m for ai in citizens_with_puppies)
postconditions.description: All citizens receiving puppies must have valid indices within the range of 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= n - 1 for bi in guardians_with_puppies)
postconditions.description: All guardians receiving puppies must have valid indices within the range of 1 to n - 1.
